description: Auditable edge decision contract. Model risk, review routing, safety urgency, and action are separate concepts.

node_id.description: Edge node that made the decision.

observed_at.description: When the source observation was made.

received_at.description: When the edge path accepted it.

decided_at.description: When the edge path completed its local decision.

latency_ms.description: Edge-local processing only; it excludes network, cloud queueing, and cloud inference.

local_prediction.description: AI4I only: normal iff calibrated failure_probability <= threshold_used. Null for uncalibrated Qwen.

raw_logit.description: Uncalibrated AI4I model score retained for later recalibration; null for Qwen.

failure_probability.description: Calibrated P(failure) for AI4I. Null for Qwen until independently calibrated.

calibration_version.description: Calibration artifact version; null means that no probability is claimed.

feature_schema_id.description: Frozen feature contract used by the model route.

threshold_used.description: The calibrated normal-accept threshold; not a safety threshold.

threshold_review_margin.description: Versioned operational review band around threshold_used. It is not a probability or confidence value.

review_reason.description: Machine-readable reason for review. Qwen fallback is always required until calibrated.

safety_priority.description: Safety urgency only, never a business priority.

safety_trigger.description: P0 requires a hard trigger such as emergency_stop or interlock_trip.

decision.description: Human-facing local result. For Qwen it contains an explicitly provisional class observation only.

invariants: suspected is a review workflow state, not a model class.
P0 is permitted only with a hard safety_trigger; model probability or a Qwen class cannot create P0.
A positive threshold_review_margin may require review around the calibrated decision boundary without changing local_prediction.
Qwen fallback sets failure_probability, calibration_version, feature_schema_id, threshold_used, and threshold_review_margin to null and review_state to required.
